crop.notes: Long column of unrelated items (checkers, cycling, Sporting Notes, Nellie McHenry, rowing, baseball, Local Brevities). Allen is named once, in the Charley White paragraph in crop-4.

ocr.notes: Gist is there but many errors, including in the Allen sentence ('the ot whee about', 'pe of Jem Mace').

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, February 24, 1897, page 6.

notes: Allen appears only as an old-time name: White mocked men 'who rarely discuss fighters this side of the days of Jem Mace, Joe Goss and Tom Allen.' No facts about Allen.
